```{r}

# YAO - Guest Composition Analysis

library(tidyverse)

# Step 1: Import the dataset
hotel_data <- read_csv("data/hotel_booking.csv",
                       show_col_types = FALSE)

# Step 2: Create four guest composition groups
guest_data <- hotel_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(adults),
         !is.na(children),
         !is.na(babies),
         adults + children + babies > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    guest_group = case_when(
      children > 0 & babies > 0 ~ "With both",
      children > 0 ~ "With children only",
      babies > 0 ~ "With babies only",
      TRUE ~ "Adults only"
    )
  )

# Step 3: Count bookings and calculate percentages
guest_summary <- guest_data %>%
  count(hotel, guest_group) %>%
  group_by(hotel) %>%
  mutate(percentage = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Display the summary table
print(guest_summary)

# Step 4: Draw two pie charts
ggplot(guest_summary,
       aes(x = "", y = percentage, fill = guest_group)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  facet_wrap(~ hotel) +

geom_text(
  aes(label = ifelse(
    percentage >= 0.05,
    scales::percent(percentage, accuracy = 0.1),
    ""
  )),
  position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
  size = 3
)

  
  labs(
    title = "Guest Composition by Hotel Type",
    fill = "Guest Group"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )


```
